instruments.instrument: INSTRUMENT 2 — Logic/model-theory null model (RRP-03 Recursion Invariant; charter and conceptual pass read in full at "/Users/mpg/Desktop/grut physics testing /rrp/rrp03/"). All web verifications fetched 2026-09-24.
instruments.verdict: Observation A VERIFIED at source (second-order categoricity is relocation to the supplied semantics/metatheory; theorem-grade on both sides of the toggle). Observation B VERIFIED with an attribution sharpening (the standard theorem is Harrington's Pi^1_1-conservativity of WKL0 over RCA0, which entails the pass's Pi^0_2 statement; the Pi^0_2 class belongs to Friedman's conservativity of WKL0 over PRA, the Hilbert-program-salvage result — cite them separately). The conservativity/EFT-decoupling analogy is SOUND as scoped-irrelevance, and the formal case is the cleaner instance (exact, theorem-grade scope boundary). Key question C: NO genuine unscoped specification-elimination found anywhere in the surveyed classes of pure logic — every candidate is a relocation (categoricity, Gentzen reductions, interpretability), a scoped conservativity (WKL0, partial Hilbert), or an elimination of provably-zero content (definitional extension, cut elimination); the one historical attempt at genuine elimination (Hilbert's program) was killed at theorem grade by Godel II. C5 caveat: this is absence-in-surveyed-classes, not a universal theorem. Adjudication D: derive-structure/supply-point/relocate-under-reformulation HOLDS in mathematics itself, and logic is the one domain where the obstructions to free elimination are themselves theorems (Lowenheim-Skolem, Lindstrom, Godel I/II). Net branch implication per the charter's pre-registration: MIXED, leaning Branch 1.

findings.claim: Observation A (core): the second-order categoricity 'elimination' of which-model consumes metatheoretic supplied content — the full power-set semantics / background set theory — and toggling that supplied item off (Henkin semantics) restores the non-standard models.
findings.status: VERIFIED AT SOURCE (theorem-grade on both sides)
findings.evidence: Vaananen, 'Second-order logic and foundations of mathematics', Bull. Symbolic Logic 7(4) (2001) 504-520 (record: https://philpapers.org/rec/VAASLA, via search 2026-09-24): full semantics characterizes central concepts categorically but 'relies entirely on informal reasoning' (the metatheory), while weak semantics 'loses its power in expressing concepts categorically'. Corroborated in Vaananen's own SEP entry 'Second-order and Higher-order Logic' (Winter 2024 ed., authorship confirmed via SEP archinfo, fetched 2026-09-24, https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/logic-higher-order/): under Henkin/general models 'any second-order theory... with an infinite general model has general models of all infinite cardinalities, and therefore cannot be categorical'; under full semantics completeness, compactness, and both Lowenheim-Skolem directions fail, and validity questions read the background set theory (truth of theta_CH equivalent to CH in the set-theoretic universe). Sharpest datum: Ajtai 1979 (as reported in the SEP entry) — whether second-order equivalence implies isomorphism for countable structures is INDEPENDENT of ZFC, i.e. the reach of the categoricity apparatus is itself fixed by the supplied metatheory.

findings.claim: First-order side: the which-model supplied point is ineliminable at first order, by theorem, not by failure of ingenuity.
findings.evidence: Lowenheim-Skolem (up+down): any first-order theory with an infinite model has models of every infinite cardinality >= |signature|; consequence stated verbatim in the fetched article (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Löwenheim–Skolem_theorem, 2026-09-24): 'a first-order theory which has an infinite model cannot be categorical.' Lindstrom's theorem (same source): first-order logic is maximal among logics having compactness + downward LS — theorem-grade statement that categoricity-grade pinning power cannot be added without paying in metatheoretic properties. Together with finding 1 this is the recursion at theorem grade: eliminate the supplied point and you must pay elsewhere; refuse to pay and the point provably stays.

findings.claim: Internal categoricity (the strongest modern candidate for elimination-without-metatheory) does not exhibit free elimination: the payment relocates into the object theory's comprehension schema plus an internalist scope restriction.
findings.evidence: Vaananen & Wang, 'Internal Categoricity in Arithmetic and Set Theory', Notre Dame J. Formal Logic 56(1) (2015) 121-134, DOI 10.1215/00294527-2835038 (projecteuclid abstract fetched 2026-09-24): 'the categoricity of second-order Peano axioms can be proved from the comprehension axioms' — inside Henkin second-order logic, no set-theoretic metatheory. Adjudication under RRP typing: the set-theoretic metatheory is genuinely removed, but (i) the proof consumes the comprehension axioms supplied in the object theory, and (ii) the result pins only internal models relative to the theory's own resources — the external 'is my universe standard' question is re-typed, not answered (Vaananen's own reading deflates that question; the standard critique keeps it — but on EITHER reading no free elimination is exhibited, and the dispute is precisely over WHERE the supplied point now sits, which is the recursion's signature). Supply-point moved metatheory -> object-theory axiom choice + scope: type conversion, not elimination.

findings.claim: Observation B (statement): WKL0 conservative over RCA0 for Pi^0_2 sentences.
findings.status: VERIFIED WITH SHARPENING / ATTRIBUTION CORRECTION for the pass
findings.evidence: True but understated, and the class-attribution should be split: (i) the standard theorem is Pi^1_1-conservativity of WKL0 over RCA0, due to Harrington (with Friedman, mid-1970s; model-theoretic/forcing proofs unpublished; exposition in Simpson, Subsystems of Second Order Arithmetic, IX.2) — confirmed via Dean-Walsh, 'The Prehistory of the Subsystems of Second-Order Arithmetic' (https://arxiv.org/pdf/1612.06219) and 'Harrington's conservation theorem redone' (Arch. Math. Logic, https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00153-008-0080-8), search records 2026-09-24; Pi^0_2 is a subclass of Pi^1_1, so the pass's sentence follows. (ii) The Pi^0_2 class is load-bearing for a DIFFERENT theorem: WKL0 is Pi^0_2-conservative over PRA (Friedman) — verified via SEP 'Hilbert's Program' (Richard Zach, rev. 2023-09-29, fetched 2026-09-24, https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/hilbert-program/): 'WKL0 is conservative over PRA for Pi^0_2 sentences.' Recommend the pass cite Harrington (Pi^1_1/RCA0) and Friedman (Pi^0_2/PRA) separately.

findings.claim: The conservativity/EFT-decoupling analogy stated in the pass (scoped-irrelevance, not elimination) is sound.
findings.status: ADJUDICATED SOUND, with two honest disanalogies recorded
findings.evidence: Shared form: relative to a declared observable class (Pi^1_1 sentences / low-energy observables) the stronger supplied item adds nothing; outside the class it provably does — WKL itself is a Pi^1_2-form statement unprovable in RCA0, so the scope boundary is exact, just as heavy content reappears at threshold. In neither case is the supplied item removed from the full system. Disanalogies (strengthening, not weakening, the pass's use): conservativity is exact (a theorem, no suppressed corrections) where decoupling carries power-suppressed residues; and the scoping parameter is a syntactic complexity class rather than an energy-plus-accuracy regime. The formal case is thus the CLEANER instance of the same scoped-irrelevance type.

findings.claim: Key question C: pure logic contains no genuine, unscoped specification-elimination in the surveyed classes — every elimination-shaped move is a relocation, a scoped conservativity, or removal of provably-zero content.
findings.status: SURVEYED; NO COUNTEREXAMPLE FOUND (C5 caveat: absence-in-surveyed-classes, not a universal theorem)
findings.evidence: Survey with obstruction/relocation analysis per item: (a) Hilbert's program — the one historical attempt at genuine unscoped elimination (discharge of ideal content via finitary certification); killed at theorem grade by Godel II (SEP Hilbert's Program, fetched 2026-09-24: a finitary consistency proof of T would formalize to a derivation 'ruled out by G2'); its salvage is exactly conservativity (Simpson's partial realizations via Friedman's WKL0/PRA result — scoped) and Gentzen-style relativized reductions, PA reduced to PRA + TI(epsilon_0) (same SEP source) — a visible relocation with type conversion (induction schema -> ordinal well-foundedness content). (b) Definitional extensions: genuine symbol removal, but the eliminability theorem certifies the supplied content was zero — the calibration point: logic eliminates for free exactly what costs nothing. (c) Cut elimination: rule removed, theorem set preserved (conservative reformulation), paid in hyperexponential proof-size blowup (Statman/Orevkov; textbook-grade) — type-conversion payment, not spec-elimination. (d) Interpretability / relative consistency (forcing, inner models): Con-transfers among supplied bases; mutual interpretability is type-honest identification of supplied content (the logic analog of RRP's conversion equivalences); the reduction chain provably cannot terminate at nothing (Godel II again). (e) Even the syntax-semantics bridge carries a price tag: Godel completeness for countable languages is EQUIVALENT to WKL0 over RCA0 (Simpson SOSOA IV.3; corroborating records https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/reverse-mathematics/ and http://pauillac.inria.fr/~herbelin/talks/ihm-godel18.pdf, search 2026-09-24). (f) Internal categoricity: see finding 3. No surveyed item removes supplied content without relocating it to a metatheory, a semantics, an axiom choice, or a scope restriction.

findings.claim: Adjudication D: derive-structure/supply-point/relocate-under-reformulation holds in mathematics itself, at the coarse grain — and more strongly there than in physics, because the obstructions to free elimination are themselves theorems.
findings.status: ADJUDICATED: HOLDS (recorded strength: theorem-grade obstructions, survey-grade universality)
findings.evidence: Composite of findings 1-6: categoricity consumes semantics or comprehension (1,3); first-order pinning is blocked by LS/Lindstrom (2); consistency consumes a stronger base or ordinal content, and the discharge loop is closed off by Godel II (6a,6d); completeness consumes WKL0 (6e); conservativity consumes an explicit scope declaration (4,5). Logic is the unique domain in the RRP corpus where 'no free elimination' is partially provable rather than merely audited.

findings.claim: Cross-feed to Instrument 4 (D1 kill condition), flagged for source verification before use: pure model theory possesses forced, derivable size-and-stratification theory of its own model spaces — Morley's categoricity-in-power theorem and Shelah's Main Gap / spectrum theorems (number of models per cardinality is either maximal or a constrained small spectrum, as a theorem).
findings.status: NOTED ONLY — textbook-grade, NOT source-verified this session; verify before any use in the discriminant hunt
findings.evidence: If confirmed, this is prima facie pressure on D1 ('physics's forced factorizations deliver the size and stratification of the supplied space as theorems'): a generic formal system whose configuration space comes with equally forced, derivable dimension/stratification theory would trip D1's stated kill condition. Not load-bearing for this instrument's verdict; recorded per the charter's default NOT-A-DISCRIMINANT-when-uncertain discipline.

instruments.argument: Two results, pulling in the charter's two pre-registered directions, both landed. First: the recursion holds in pure formalism, and at the sharp grain — Observation A is verified at source and is stronger than the pass stated it, because both halves of the relocation are theorem-grade. Second-order categoricity eliminates 'which model' exactly insofar as the full power-set semantics is supplied from the metatheory; withdraw that supplied item (Henkin semantics) and non-standard models provably return (all infinite cardinalities); refuse second-order resources entirely and Lowenheim-Skolem makes the supplied point provably ineliminable at first order; and Lindstrom's theorem says the trade itself is forced — pinning power cannot be added to first-order logic without surrendering compactness or downward LS. Ajtai's independence result is the capstone: how far the categoricity apparatus reaches is itself independent of ZFC, i.e. decided by the metatheoretic supplied content. Internal categoricity, the strongest modern attempt to dodge this, removes the set-theoretic metatheory only by relocating payment into the object theory's comprehension axioms plus an internalist scope restriction — a type conversion under RRP typing, and the live philosophical dispute about it is over where the supplied point now sits, never over whether one exists. Per the charter this SUPPORTS BRANCH 1 at the coarse grain: a recursion that pure mathematics exhibits at theorem grade cannot be a physics-specific fact about nature. Second: the key-question survey found no genuine unscoped specification-elimination anywhere in the surveyed classes of logic — Hilbert's program was precisely the attempt at one and was killed by Godel II at theorem grade; its salvage (conservativity, Gentzen-style reductions) is scoped-irrelevance and relocation respectively; definitional extension and cut elimination remove only provably-zero specification content; interpretability chains cannot terminate at nothing; even the completeness bridge costs exactly WKL0. Observation B is verified (with the Harrington-Pi^1_1/RCA0 vs Friedman-Pi^0_2/PRA attribution split the pass should adopt), and the EFT-decoupling analogy is sound — indeed the formal case is the cleaner instance of scoped-irrelevance, being exact. Per the charter's own pre-registration this second result is MIXED, and here is what it does to the fork: the null model was to serve as a CONTRAST class — if logic contained genuine eliminations, their absence in physics would be a remarkable, possibly nature-tracking fact, and Branch 2 could live on elimination-existence alone. Logic contains none (in the surveyed classes). So the invariant-candidate's content holds in the null too, which simultaneously (i) confirms Branch 1's reading at the coarse grain — the recursion is architecture of formal description as such — and (ii) strips the null model of its power to separate the branches by elimination-existence, transferring the entire discriminating burden to Instrument 1's vacuity adjudication and to the discriminant hunt D1-D4. Branch 2 can now live only as a quantitative discriminant claim, never as an elimination-existence claim; and this instrument already puts survey-grade pressure on D1 (model theory's own spectrum/stratification theorems — flagged, unverified) while leaving D3/D4 untouched. One honest asymmetry cuts slightly against a complacent Branch-1 close: in logic the no-free-elimination pattern is partially THEOREM-grade, whereas in the physics ledgers it is audit-grade; if anything, the null exhibits the invariant more strongly than the physics does — a further reason the burden of proof stays on Branch 2, exactly where the charter placed it. Net enum: MIXED, leaning Branch 1, with the lean carried by finding 7 and the MIXED component carried by the contrast-removal just described. Nothing here proposes ontology; survival of the recursion in logic is a fact about description architecture, not truth about nature. Sources (all fetched 2026-09-24): https://philpapers.org/rec/VAASLA ; https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/logic-higher-order/ (author confirmed Jouko Vaananen, Winter 2024 ed.) ; https://projecteuclid.org/journals/notre-dame-journal-of-formal-logic/volume-56/issue-1/Internal-Categoricity-in-Arithmetic-and-Set-Theory/10.1215/00294527-2835038.full ; https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/hilbert-program/ ; https://arxiv.org/pdf/1612.06219 ; https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00153-008-0080-8 ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Löwenheim–Skolem_theorem ; https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/reverse-mathematics/ ; http://pauillac.inria.fr/~herbelin/talks/ihm-godel18.pdf

instruments.instrument: RRP-03 Instrument 3 — Engineered-systems null model (charter: /Users/mpg/Desktop/grut physics testing /rrp/rrp03/RRP_03_CHARTER.md; pass: /Users/mpg/Desktop/grut physics testing /rrp/rrp03/RRP_03_CONCEPTUAL_PASS_01.md)
instruments.verdict: The coarse recursion (derive-structure / supply-point / relocate-under-reformulation) holds TRIVIALLY in specification stacks containing no physics — compiler/runtime stacks, protocol stacks, HDL synthesis, axiomatic game design all exhibit it, and their apparent eliminations decompose exactly as the program's class-4 record does: redundancy quotients, scoped reductions, or relocations, never strict reductions. On the contrast inventory: D1 is NOT-A-DISCRIMINANT at its stated grain (its kill condition fires — exact derived-dimension theorems and consistency-forced stratification are commonplace in the null class), and its sharpened residual-freedom form is not independent: it reduces to D3, because derived dimensions of measured-residual spaces appear in engineering exactly where a measured record enters (system identification, Buckingham pi). D2's directionality-existence is NOT-A-DISCRIMINANT (engineered relocation has forced one-way conversions); its specific discrete-to-continuum conversion is genuinely absent from the null, but that absence is the absence of measured continua per se — again D3's territory. D4, corrected (engineered payments are purely conventional only in the stack INTERIOR; every real stack pays non-conventionally at its two boundaries), SURVIVES this null strengthened: the null demonstrates that purely-logical-payment derivations are possible in specification systems as such, so their total absence from the ~14 audited physics ledgers is informative rather than architecturally forced. Net: strong Branch-1 support at the coarse grain; the discriminant hunt narrows to an anchoring cluster (D3 restated non-circularly via ledger-entry identity conditions) plus D4.

findings.claim: (1) PRIMARY ADJUDICATION: derive-structure/supply-point/relocate holds in engineered stacks — trivially yes, said plainly.
findings.evidence: Compiler/runtime: type safety (progress+preservation) is derived given supplied typing rules and annotations; the memory model's guarantees are derived given supplied happens-before annotations; configuration remains supplied in flags, target triples, sysroots, linker scripts, ABIs. Reformulation relocates rather than eliminates: autoconf moves platform assumptions out of code into build-time probes (the value is then supplied by measuring the build environment — supply relocated from human to environment-record, not eliminated); cross-compilation moves them into target triple + sysroot; C-to-Rust migration relocates memory-safety suppliedness from programmer discipline into lifetime/ownership annotations; TypeScript-to-JS transpilation relocates type suppliedness into build-time annotations and erases it at the boundary (guarantees hold only source-side); garbage collection eliminates per-callsite free() decisions at the price of a collector mechanism plus new global knobs (heap sizes, pause targets) — relocation with structure debt. Protocol stacks: each layer's contract is derived given supplied parameters (TCP's reliable stream over IP given timeouts/window/congestion constants); every trust derivation bottoms out at a supplied anchor (PKI root CA store, DNSSEC root KSK, secure-boot root of trust) and every re-architecture relocates the anchor, never eliminates it; the end-to-end argument states the no-elimination principle explicitly — reliability 'can completely and correctly be implemented only with the knowledge and help of the application standing at the endpoints' (Saltzer, Reed, Clark, ACM TOCS 2(4):277-288, 1984; verified at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/End-to-end_principle, fetched 2026-09-24). HDL: synthesis derives netlist guarantees given supplied SDC timing constraints, pin maps, clock definitions. Game design: rules derive game-tree structure; komi in Go is a supplied balance parameter tuned against a record of play. All common-knowledge engineering except the cited 1984 paper.

findings.claim: (1b) Engineered 'eliminations' decompose exactly as the physics record does: redundancy quotient, scoped reduction, or relocation — no strict reductions found.
findings.status: CONFIRMED (Branch-1 supporting; reproduces the class-4 gate's record structure in the null)
findings.evidence: Hindley-Milner type inference eliminates supplied annotations only because they were redundant given the term (principal types) — a redundancy quotient, the same shape as the flavor-basis quotient in K_ROUND_SYNTHESIS.md section 4; and the supply returns exactly when the type system is enriched (full System F inference undecidable — common knowledge). Dropping platform config on a port is a scoped reduction (the record narrows: that platform is no longer targeted) — the pass's section 1 firewall applies verbatim. Everything else examined is relocation. I found no engineered map that is strictly reducing at honest typing.

findings.claim: (2) D1 as stated ('forced, derivable dimension theory of the specification structure') — kill condition FIRES; commonplace in the null class.
findings.evidence: Three counterexamples. (a) Myhill-Nerode (1957): the minimal DFA's state count equals the index of the Nerode congruence and 'the minimal DFA is unique up to unique isomorphism' — an exact derived-size theorem in pure formalism (verified at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Myhill%E2%80%93Nerode_theorem, fetched 2026-09-24). (b) Ho-Kalman (1966): 'a classical result by Ho and Kalman reveals the McMillan degree as the rank of a Hankel matrix built from these measurements', minimal realizations unique up to similarity — an exact derived-dimension theorem inside an engineered discipline (verified at https://arxiv.org/abs/1803.00043 fetched 2026-09-24; corroborated via https://www.sciencedirect.com/topics/mathematics/minimal-realization, searched 2026-09-24). (c) Type universes: Type:Type is inconsistent (Girard 1972; 'the original version of Per Martin-Löf's type theory... is inconsistent', verified at https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Girard%27s+paradox fetched 2026-09-24; Hurkens, 'A Simplification of Girard's Paradox', TLCA 1995, https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/BFb0014058, searched 2026-09-24) — so consistency FORCES well-founded stratification of the universe hierarchy: a genuine consistency-forced stratification of part of a type system's own specification apparatus. Honest limits of (c): consistency derives the obstruction and the qualitative stratification only, not the dimension — the repair space is open (predicative hierarchy, impredicative Prop, cumulativity, universe polymorphism are design choices). Configuration lattices (feature models, Kconfig) are NOT counterexamples: their structure is derived from supplied constraint declarations, not from internal consistency.

findings.claim: (2b) D1 sharpened to 'derived dimension of the RESIDUAL measured-freedom space' (the 13 = (36-26)+(18-15) flavor-invariant count; rank-one-per-mode) — real distinction from the null's canonical-form theorems, but NOT INDEPENDENT: it reduces to D3.
findings.evidence: The engineered exact-count theorems (Myhill-Nerode, Ho-Kalman as realization theory) price the canonical form of a FULLY specified behavior — no residual freedom remains; the flavor count prices how many dials remain to be MEASURED. That distinction is real. But it is not architectural: engineered disciplines derive residual-measured-freedom dimensions precisely when they face a measured record — Ho-Kalman in system-identification mode derives the dimension of the model whose parameters must then be estimated from plant data; Buckingham pi derives the count of residual dimensionless groups (n minus rank of the dimensional matrix) from supplied unit assignments. In both, the derived-residual-dimension pattern appears if and only if the specification system is coupled to something measured. So the discriminating property is the anchoring, and the dimension theory follows wherever anchoring goes: D1-sharpened is a shadow of D3. Per the binding default (NOT-A-DISCRIMINANT when uncertain): D1 is not independent.

findings.claim: (3) D2 as 'existence of forced type-conversion directionality in relocation' — kill condition FIRES; engineered relocation has forced one-way conversions.
findings.evidence: (a) Static/dynamic asymmetry: any compile-time decision can be deferred to runtime, but hoisting general semantic decisions to compile time is obstructed by Rice's theorem (undecidability of non-trivial semantic properties — common knowledge, 1953); relocation toward late binding is free, toward early binding is obstructed. (b) The compile boundary is lossy one-way: source-to-binary erases types, names, and structure; decompilation cannot in general recover them. (c) The GC ledger has the same signature as the audited SO(10) payment (RRP_02_VERDICT_01.md row A1): many discrete per-site supplied decisions exchanged for a few global magnitude knobs plus mechanism debt — compression paid in parameter-plus-structure debt. So the PHENOMENON of directed conversion with debt exists with zero physics present.

findings.claim: (3b) D2's specific conversion TYPE (discrete into a genuine continuum) is demonstrably ABSENT from the null class — but the absence folds into the anchoring cluster.
findings.evidence: No interior engineered specification item is a point of a continuum knowable only through measurement: flags, enums, window sizes, universe levels, sequence-number widths are finite/enumerable or stipulated-exact, with decidable equality. Even the GC's 'magnitude' knobs are stipulated integers. The discrete-to-continuous+structure-debt conversion cannot be expressed in the null because the null has no measured continua to convert into — which is the anchoring property again, not an independent directionality fact. Where real-valued config does appear in engineering (SDC timing in nanoseconds, PHY channel parameters, PID gains), physics has entered through the plant — the exception proves the reduction.

findings.claim: (4) D4's premise 'engineered payments are purely conventional/logical' — WRONG as stated at the stack boundaries; RIGHT in the interior; and the corrected version STRENGTHENS D4.
findings.status: CORRECTED, THEN SURVIVES-THIS-NULL (the instrument's strongest pro-discriminant finding; survival is not truth)
findings.evidence: Correction: every real engineered stack pays non-conventionally at exactly two boundaries — the bottom (physical substrate: timing constraints from silicon characterization, PHY channel parameters, linker physical memory maps) and the top (requirements: supplied facts about what is wanted, underivable within the stack). The recursion in engineered systems terminates precisely where physics or purposes enter. But the INTERIOR contains derivations whose entire payment is conventional/logical: type safety consumes only supplied typing rules and annotations; parser correctness only the grammar; a protocol layer's correctness proof only the contract of the layer below. Consequence for D4: the null class demonstrates that purely-logical-payment derivations are POSSIBLE in specification systems as such — the contrast class is nonempty — so the reported total absence of such derivations from the ~14 audited physics ledgers (every audited structure-derivation consumed couplings, states, or selections) is an informative fact about the physics instances, not an artifact of specification architecture. Caveats carried: D4's own kill condition (a physics instance paying only metatheoretic content) is testable only against the physics record, not by this instrument; and 'pays in physical content' risks definitional entanglement with D3 — flagged for the synthesis and instrument 4.

findings.claim: (5) Sharpest ANALOGIES (Branch-1 feeding).
findings.evidence: A1: conservation-and-relocation is exact and ubiquitous with zero physics present — root-of-trust chains are the cleanest single witness (trust is derived structure; the anchor is the supplied point; no re-architecture in the history of PKI/DNSSEC/secure boot has eliminated it), with the end-to-end argument as the stated in-discipline no-elimination principle. A2: exact derived dimension theory exists in the null (Myhill-Nerode; Ho-Kalman) — the physics program's proudest D1 exhibit has formal-system cousins. A3: the null reproduces the fine structure of the no-elimination record (quotient / scope / relocation trichotomy, finding 1b), not just its coarse statement. A4: the requirements spec plus substrate constraints jointly play R(D)'s structural role — underivable from inside, preserved by admissible maps (porting IS the record-preserving map class: behavior fixed, configuration relocated), with the recursion terminating at the stack's boundary with the non-formal, the same shape as physics.

findings.claim: (6) Sharpest DISANALOGIES — what the physics instances possess that the null demonstrably lacks (feeding the discriminant hunt).
findings.evidence: Z1 (feeds D4): interior purely-conventional-payment derivations exist in the null and, on the audited record, nowhere in the physics ledgers. Z2 (feeds D3, stated non-circularly): supplied-item IDENTITY CONDITIONS differ in kind — engineered supplied items have decidable exact equality and are stipulations, revisable by the agent who supplies them; physics's supplied couplings are equivalence classes of measurement-compatible values (error-bar identity), fixed by the world, unrevisable. This restates D3 as a property of ledger-entry identity conditions rather than as 'physics is the anchored case by definition' — a candidate non-circular form for instrument 4. Z3 (weaker, partly sociological — flagged as such): the null's record (requirements) is renegotiable by the same agents who build the maps, and non-record-preserving maps are routine and cheap there; physics's record-preservation constraint on M has an external enforcer. Z4 (absence list, direct answer to the task): the null lacks (a) supplied continua-under-measurement, (b) derivations pricing residual MEASURED freedom absent a plant, (c) non-conventional payment anywhere in the interior, (d) an unrevisable record.

instruments.argument: This instrument's findings cut in two directions, with the weight on Branch 1. Toward Branch 1: the recursion holds trivially in specification systems with no physics in them, and it holds at fine grain — engineered stacks reproduce not only derive-structure/supply-point/relocate but the exact trichotomy of the program's no-elimination record (redundancy quotients, scoped reductions, relocations; no strict reductions), and they possess their own exact derived-dimension theorems (Myhill-Nerode 1957; Ho-Kalman 1966) and consistency-forced stratification (Girard 1972 / Hurkens 1995). That kills D1 at its stated grain and D2 at the directionality-existence grain, per their own pre-registered kill conditions, and it confirms that the coarse phenomenon is a property of the architecture of layered formal description as such. Toward Branch 2, two residues survive this null honestly: (i) D4, corrected — the null proves purely-logical-payment derivations are possible in specification systems, so their total absence from the audited physics ledgers is informative rather than architectural; (ii) a non-circular restatement of D3 — physics's supplied items differ in identity conditions (error-bar equivalence classes fixed by the world) from the null's (decidable, stipulated, revisable), and the derived-residual-dimension pattern (D1-sharpened) follows that anchoring wherever it goes, including into engineering itself via system identification and Buckingham pi. The instrument therefore hands the synthesis a narrowed hunt, not a verdict: everything the pass treated as four candidate discriminants collapses under the engineered null into one anchoring cluster (D3-restated) plus D4, both untested on their physics-side kill conditions by this instrument. Under the binding default the collapse of D1 and D2 counts for Branch 1 now; the survival of D4 and D3-restated keeps Branch 2 live but proves nothing — survival is not truth. D1, D2, D3, D4: all NOT-A-DISCRIMINANT, each killed by its own birth-named kill condition — D1 by three independent null-side domains with forced, derivable dimension theory (parametricity/free theorems; Böhm–Berarducci inhabitant classification; Shelah's Main Gap; Post's lattice), D2 on the program's own record (n=1 compression instance plus the reverse conversion direction exhibited in the A3/A2 ledgers), D3 by honest concession after every non-circular restatement tried was either instantiated by reverse mathematics or collapsed to the definition of the subject, D4 by a typing dilemma with near-counterexamples in the record's own audits. Sci. 39 (1985) 135-154, search-record verified (sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/0304397585901355; okmij.org/ftp/tagless-final/course/Boehm-Berarducci.html): the closed normal terms of forall a.(a->a)->a->a are EXACTLY the Church numerals — the inhabitant space forced isomorphic to N as a theorem, the direct null analog of the program's derived Z-typed and Delta^{n-1}-typed images. Commonplace across typed lambda-calculus, model theory, and universal algebra: kill condition met. instruments.argument: The hunt was run with the burden where the charter puts it — on the discriminant — and no candidate carried it. D1, the load-bearing candidate, dies cleanly: the specific thing claimed as distinctively physical (the size and stratification of the supplied space delivered as theorems by forced structure) is commonplace in generic specification systems, exhibited in three mutually independent null-side domains verified at source on 2026-09-24 — parametricity (Wadler 1989: a theorem about every inhabitant derived from the type alone, via Reynolds), Böhm–Berarducci (the inhabitant space of a System-F type forced isomorphic to N as a theorem — the exact analog of the program's derived Z and Delta^{n-1} images), Shelah's Main Gap (forced dimension theory, complete with tree-of-invariants stratification, on model theory's own supplied space of 'which model', for ALL countable theories), and Post's lattice (a theorem-grade complete stratification of an entire specification space). None of these is the physics-adjacent moduli case the task flagged; all are logic/CS. D2 dies on the program's own record: one compression instance is not a pattern, and the A3/A2 ledgers themselves book the reverse conversion direction (continuous Lambda into discrete flux integers plus a higher-type measure). D3 — given the mandated special attention — was given its best non-circular chance and killed honestly: the joint-pinning/constraint-satisfaction restatement the task proposed is instantiated by reverse mathematics (one shared theorem-corpus jointly pinning all subsystem ledgers, with mechanically derived cross-structure and the emergent Big Five stratification — the program's own CONTROL6 screen already held this object), the eliminative direction-of-fit restatement is matched by record-driven non-implication refutations, and what remains after every restatement is exactly 'physics is the anchored case' — the definition of the subject, which the kill condition itself names as the concession outcome. D4 is not even well-posed as a checkable difference: its truth flips with the physical-vs-logical typing of items like unitarity and crossing, a convention the program cannot independently fix (NOT-FORMALIZABLE-TYPE-MIXED one level up), and on the strict typing the record's own audits supply the killing instances (A5's bootstrap exclusions paid in 'F-content, not S-content'; the safe-group theorem; D=10 from Weyl-anomaly cancellation). Three new candidates surfaced from the data (the A5 grade gradient toward the actual S; the theta-bar/rank interlock; the quotient-kernel/flow-residue coexistence) and all three are matched by commonplace formal-system phenomena (the decidability/completeness frontier; the RM Zoo's derived interdependence; alpha/parametricity quotients plus normalization residues). The synthesis-level finding is the factorization: every precise candidate decomposes into an architecture factor the nulls match plus an anchoring factor that is definitional — meaning the recursion's observable signatures are description-architecture through and through, and what the physics instances distinctively add is only that they are physics. Consequence for the fork: Branch 2 requires a surviving discriminant BY DEFINITION of the charter's fork, independent of whatever the formalization instrument finds for II-double-prime — so on this instrument's result, Branch 2 has no leg to stand on, and the branch verdict should default to Branch 1 unless another instrument produces a discriminant this hunt missed. Limits, recorded per binding: single instrument, read-level; null-side verifications at author-page/search-record level (Wadler fetched; Böhm–Berarducci, Main Gap, Post, SEP-RM at search-record level; Church-Rosser/strong normalization, Presburger, Gödel, omega-model refutations, conformance-suite practice carried at textbook-standard grade, marked not fetched); the D5 sharp-grain comparison was not closed either way (resolved by default rule, not by proof); absence of a surviving discriminant is not proof of Branch 1's truth — it is absence of support for Branch 2, at recorded strength. instruments.argument: The formalization attack succeeds, honestly qualified. (1) The typed extraction closes: 9 types, refined from the audits' own vocabulary, absorb every item in the 14 core ledgers plus the crunch refinements with no residue. (2) The comparison was defined before application, and not invented fresh: it operationalizes the certificate grammar the audits already used (identity / certified relocation-conversion / certified payment-for-derivation; strict = typed subset-with-remainder, the challenge round's own residue formula). (3) On the quantification domain of (II'') — pairs connected by an actual audited map — comparability is total: 19/19, with 9 certified equivalences (including the field's own three-way contour↔saddle↔Robin interconversion, source-verified), 9 strict relations, 1 accounting-only pair, 0 incomparable, and 0 strict reductions. The vacuity risk named at (II'')'s birth was that incomparability would dominate; it does not — and crucially, non-vacuity is earned, because the very detector that would certify a reduction (absolute remainder plus closed payment) fires nine times on this record in the mirror direction. 'No strictly reducing maps' therefore excludes something the order demonstrably expresses; its truth on this record is an empirical fact about 19 audited maps, not a definitional artifact. Verdict: II''-FORMALIZABLE-NONVACUOUS. Three qualifications bind the verdict and feed the fork. First, the order is graph-local: certificates exist only on audited edges, so (II'') is contentful exactly as stated (maps-quantified) and no global-poset reading is licensed. Second, sensitivity is asymmetric: reductions are harder to certify than increases, and on the one TYPE-BLOCKED pair (CPR — the record's paradigm cross-type trade) the invariant holds by refusal rather than verification; had that class dominated, the verdict would have been II''-VACUOUS. Third, the hostile-bookkeeper test shows the order is computed-independently only relative to two declared conventions — per-description ledger closure and record preservation in 𝔐 — which defeat the two strongest retyping attacks (Tomita–Takesaki double-booking; SO(10) flavor-scoping); those conventions predate (II'') and were applied by steelman-first audits actively hunting the class-4 event, but they are practice, not theorem. EQUIV-versus-INCREASE assignments wobble under granularity redraws in about four pairs; the zero-reduction result does not wobble in any redraw tried. Branch implication is MIXED and must be stated as such: non-vacuity removes one pre-registered Branch-1 route (vacuous-order) and keeps the invariant candidate alive and killable — Branch 2's precondition, no more. But the content the formalization actually found leans the other way: every strict relation points monotonically toward more suppliedness in the deeper theory, and all nine strict-increase certificates are construction-side machinery (breaking sectors, SUSY declarations, desert, measures, truncations, added boundary conditions) — precisely the signature Branch 1 predicts, since new frameworks introduce new specification spaces by construction; and the order's own well-definedness is relative to bookkeeping conventions, a Branch-1-flavored fact about description architecture. Nothing here discriminates the physics instances from generic specification systems — that burden now rests entirely on the null models and the discriminant hunt (Instruments 2–4), and survival of (II'') on 19 in-house, read-level edges is survival, not truth.
